test_dataframe_filter_items: test the DataFrame.filter method with explicit items list to select specific columns
test_dataframe_filter_like: test the DataFrame.filter method with like parameter to select columns matching a substring
test_dataframe_filter_regex: test the DataFrame.filter method with regex parameter to select columns matching a pattern
test_dataframe_filter_axis: test the DataFrame.filter method with axis parameter to filter rows or columns
test_dataframe_filter_mutually_exclusive: test the DataFrame.filter method raises TypeError when items, like, and regex are used together
